mcqs.question: A student lifts a 20 kg box vertically through a height of 2 m in 5 seconds. What is the power delivered by the student? (Take g = 9.8 m s⁻²)
mcqs.explanation: Work done = m g h = 20 kg × 9.8 m s⁻² × 2 m = 392 J. Power = work ÷ time = 392 J ÷ 5 s = 78.4 W ≈ 78 W. Option A is correct. The other options arise from common mistakes: treating power as work × time (B), dividing by height instead of time (C), or forgetting the mass (D).

mcqs.learning_point: Understand watt as the SI unit
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines the SI unit "watt"?

options.A: One joule of energy transferred per second
options.B: One newton‑metre of work done per second
options.C: One joule of energy transferred per minute
options.D: One newton of force applied per metre

mcqs.answer: One joule of energy transferred per second
mcqs.explanation: A watt (W) is defined as one joule (J) of energy transferred or work done each second (J s⁻¹). Option A states this definition precisely. Option B mixes units (newton‑metre is a joule, but the definition is already covered by joule per second). Option C uses per minute, which is incorrect. Option D describes a unit of pressure, not power.

mcqs.learning_point: Relate power to work and time
mcqs.question: Machine A does 500 J of work in 10 s, while Machine B does 300 J of work in 5 s. Which machine has the greater power output?

options.D: Cannot be determined from the given data

mcqs.explanation: Power = work ÷ time. Machine A: 500 J ÷ 10 s = 50 W. Machine B: 300 J ÷ 5 s = 60 W. Since 60 W > 50 W, Machine B has the higher power. Option B is correct. Option A is a common mistake of comparing work alone. Option C ignores the time factor, and Option D is false because the required data are provided.

mcqs.question: Two electric kettles are used to boil the same amount of water requiring 300 kJ of energy. Kettle X is rated at 1500 W and Kettle Y at 1000 W. Assuming 100 % efficiency, which kettle will boil the water faster?

options.C: Both will take the same time
options.D: It depends on the voltage supplied

mcqs.explanation: Time = energy ÷ power. For Kettle X: 300 kJ ÷ 1500 W = 200 s. For Kettle Y: 300 kJ ÷ 1000 W = 300 s. Because Kettle X has the higher power rating, it delivers the required energy in less time, so it boils the water faster. Option A is correct. Option B ignores the power difference. Option C would be true only if the powers were equal. Option D is irrelevant because the power rating already accounts for voltage and current under rated conditions.
